attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server on the private network (eth1, 10.50.50.0/24, static IP 10.50.50.254) shared with node2/node3, and confirmed node2 and node3 (enp8s0, already set to ipv4.method=auto rather than static) obtain their addresses dynamically from node1 (leases 10.50.50.101 and 10.50.50.100 respectively). Verified inter-node connectivity across the private network, then completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of the DHCP server and client leases after each reboot.
